As I wrote in the review of Alien FE, I like this game more. Compared to the beta versions, clear improvements in the gameplay can be seen.
A strategy and the right settings are required, which can be a problem due to the higher difficulties in the public arena. There are still manageable shortcomings if a teammate loses the connection and loses his weapons even if he joins. I believe it will improve over time.

Stop haters, i miss the game, :D

The gameplay is pretty fun, also there is a lot of levels and the each level is pretty long as well. Although some of the later
levels use the same maps again.

There are a couple types of special enemies, and each type has 3 variation. The card system made this game has a lot of variety as well, but you need quite a bit of playing before you can unlock all the cards.

The AI teammates are really stupid, they don't do much in more complex levels like the last boss.

There aren't much special mechanics in this game, fairly simple and straight forward to play.

To conclude, the gameplay is fun and challenging even on the easiest difficulty without human teammates and there is only a little bit of story in this game. 

Finally, this game is always online and it is not a good feature

This is a good game with a few flaws, 8.5 out 10 marks.

This game won't launch past the EAC startup. I have tried every fix that I can find and nothing works. I have spent hours trying to get this game to launch with no results. 

Update(4/15/2022): After a 13.7 Gb update the game still didn't work. So I deleted the easy anti-cheat folder, validated, and now it works...
2nd Update: Same day.... The game went back to not working...
 3rd update(4/21/2022): Turning off my anti-virus before launching the game now allows consistent game launches. This solution, when attempted prior to recent update, didn't solve the problem, but now does...

Played the game around 40 hours by now.
Its kinda fun to play with friends - if u play with randoms its a pain in the a**.
Then u have braindead in front and beside you.

The game itself is like left for dead. It is a bit deeper, but not that much.
The card thing is pretty cool. It is possible to make up different playstyle with them.

Ive only played the campaign with friends on veteran, thats a bit difficult, but not impossible. Just right.
Needed nearly 40 hours to finish it, because sometimes we got kinda hard stuck.

The levels are sometimes used twice, but they are still different. 
If u play the same level again, it always has different mods. So it does not get boring that fast.

All in all a good game. Im not sure if its 60€ good.
If you can get it in an offer and u have friends to play with, buy it.
just shoot and keep playing, not much to say
